header_row_idx = None
for row_idx in range(1, 10):
    row_values = [ws.cell(row=row_idx, column=col).value for col in range(1, 11)]
    if "Date" in row_values and "Time" in row_values:

if header_row_idx:

        return val
    try:
        return pd.to_datetime(val, format='%H:%M:%S').time()
